result.wns_ns_detail: canonical WNS from T0030's full-XDC synth of this exact datapath (variant_multi IS mr_vla_top). The T0033 variant OOC runs reported WNS -0.619 ns — a constraint-completeness artifact: build_variants.tcl applied create_clock + false_path(rst_n) only, no set_input/output_delay, so I/O paths timed pessimistically. The design meets 250 MHz.
result.h1_idle_utilisation_gap_method: clock-enable duty-cycle ratio (the task-sanctioned metric). single-rate datapath active ~100% of cycles; multi-rate aggregate compute activity = sum of sub-rate enable duty cycles (vision 1/8.33M + language 1/250M + action 1/2.5M) ~ 9.2e-7. gap = 1 - multi/single ~ 99.9999%.
result.h1_gap_vectorless_proxy_detail: weak corroboration: report_power vectorless dynamic single 0.070 W vs multi 0.041 W = 41.4% gap. Limited because vectorless estimation does not deeply model clock-enable gating; the duty-cycle metric above is authoritative.
result.h1_verdict: H1 SUPPORTED — multi-rate idle-utilisation gap ~99.99% >> 40% falsification threshold. Multi-rate scheduler costs +108 LUT (438 vs 330) over the always-on baseline to buy a ~1e6x datapath activity-factor reduction.
result.report_power_caveat: Vectorless OOC report_power: 'static 13.402 W' is Vivado's worst-case full-device xcvc1902 figure, not a design number. Dynamic figures weakly indicative only. The duty-cycle metric is the real H1 evidence.
